summary_en: JG44 Inc. has initiated a tender offer to acquire all common shares and warrants of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE Co., Ltd. (TSE Growth Market, code 7133). The offer includes common stock and three series of warrants (Series 3, 4, and 5). Specific offer price, tender period, and minimum/maximum acceptance thresholds were not disclosed in the available text.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares and Warrants of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE Co., Ltd. (Security Code: 7133) by JG44 Inc.
translation_en_brief:
JG44 Inc., announced on September 25, 2026, the commencement of a tender offer to acquire all common shares and warrants of HYUGA PRIMARY CARE Co., Ltd., which is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market under code 7133. The offer encompasses common stock and three series of warrants: Series 3 warrants (exercisable from February 17, 2020 through February 16, 2028), Series 4 warrants (exercisable from March 24, 2022 through March 23, 2030), and Series 5 warrants (exercisable from July 1, 2022 through March 2, 2031). These warrants were issued pursuant to extraordinary general meetings of shareholders held on February 16, 2018, March 23, 2020, and February 25, 2021, respectively.

The tender offer is being conducted under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. The first two pages of the disclosure do not contain specific terms such as the offer price per share, the tender offer period, minimum acceptance thresholds, maximum acceptance limits, or the board's recommendation regarding the offer. A detailed information document was referenced as an attachment but was not included in the available text excerpt.
